title: The instrument itself: every check the mutation harness makes
note: Every claim that an enforcement point is load-bearing is produced by tools/mutation_matrix.py. If one of ITS checks stops working, the result is not a wrong number in a table -- it is an unprotected security check certified as protected. So the harness is mutated with its own machinery. The outer process has already imported the file, so mutating it on disk affects only the copy each test makes, which is exactly the subject under test. H4 is the sharpest: it reintroduces the stale-bytecode defect, under which a mutation's verdict describes code the harness did not write.

mutations.name: H1_red_baseline_ignored
mutations.find:
rc, failed = run_suite(suites, args.python)
    if rc != 0:
mutations.replace:
rc, failed = run_suite(suites, args.python)
    if False:
mutations.rationale: a matrix run against an already-failing suite reports every mutation as killed, for the pre-existing reason

mutations.name: H2_flaky_baseline_accepted
mutations.find:
rc2, failed2 = run_suite(suites, args.python)
        if rc2 == 0:
mutations.replace:
rc2, failed2 = run_suite(suites, args.python)
        if False:
mutations.rationale: a baseline that can flake red can flake green, and a green flake reports kills nothing tested

mutations.name: H3_anchor_drift_becomes_a_skip
mutations.rationale: a mutation whose anchor no longer matches is silently skipped while still appearing in the report

mutations.name: H4_stale_bytecode_reused
mutations.rationale: a mutation runs against a cached module, so its verdict describes code the harness did not write

mutations.name: H5_bytecode_cache_shared_between_runs
mutations.rationale: a shared cache reintroduces cross-mutation contamination one level up

mutations.name: H6_specification_not_validated
mutations.rationale: a typo in a specification reaches the point where a source file has already been written to

mutations.name: H7_no_op_mutation_accepted
mutations.rationale: a mutation that changes nothing is reported as killed by whatever else the suite covers

mutations.name: H8_duplicate_names_accepted
mutations.rationale: a report naming a mutation no longer says which mutation it describes

mutations.name: H9_missing_mutation_fields_accepted
mutations.find: if not isinstance(m.get(field), str) or not m.get(field):
mutations.rationale: a specification missing 'find' crashes mid-loop on a tree already written to

mutations.name: H10_recovery_sidecar_ignored
mutations.rationale: a run starts on a tree a previous interrupted run may have left mutated, and reports results about it

mutations.name: H11_sources_not_restored
mutations.find:
(ROOT / path).write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")
                damaged = [f for f in _dirty_tracked_files()
mutations.rationale: a disabled safety guard is left on disk for whoever runs git add next

mutations.name: H12_post_run_baseline_not_checked
mutations.rationale: state a mutation left behind that the source hash cannot see is reported as a clean restoration

mutations.name: H13_survivors_do_not_fail_the_run
mutations.find:
return 0 if not (survived or anchors or drifted or collateral
                     or still_dirty or post_rc) else 1
mutations.rationale: an unprotected enforcement point exits green, so CI never sees it

mutations.name: H14_survived_reported_as_killed
mutations.find:
if rc != 0:
                by = f"  by {failed[0]}" if failed else ""
mutations.replace:
if rc == 0 or rc != 0:
                by = f"  by {failed[0]}" if failed else ""
mutations.rationale: every mutation is reported killed regardless of what the suite did
